before.body:
**Degree-seven pair exclusion: $\{X_0,Y_0\}$ (family 13).** The exact-rational packet reports exclusion of this complete character-pair denominator space, retaining all numerator corrections and unrestricted $Q$.

The reduced system has 13 denominator parameters, 58 Koszul corrections and 244 coefficient equations. Square identities force $a_1=a_8=0$ and
$$3a_6-6a_7+a_9+a_{11}+a_{12}=0.$$
The remaining necessary equations include eleven bilinear forms in two groups of five parameters. The 25 charts that normalize one nonzero coordinate from each group all have rational unit certificates. Thus one group must vanish, reducing to an already-excluded single-character case.

Together with the other pair certificates, including `fqlx`'s family-30 calculation, this completes the reported **9,453 pairs among 138 degree-seven characters**. Three or more characters and higher degrees remain open; the unconditional denominator lower bound remains seven. No existence certificate or Lean proof is claimed.

[Argument and reproduction commands](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/5a1683fb82217aa49450614dc78d3b3e18b768c1/notes/x0-y0-exclusion.md) · [algebra](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/5a1683fb82217aa49450614dc78d3b3e18b768c1/algebra/degree7_x0_y0.py) · [certificate](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/5a1683fb82217aa49450614dc78d3b3e18b768c1/results/degree7-x0-y0/certificate.json.gz).

Prepared with AI assistance for `rbajaj5`, building on the shared character analysis.

before.body:
Another exact partial result for **holdout**, with the protected $(F,q,A)$ unchanged: a proposed degree-twelve conic-denominator family, and its entire four-dimensional constant-coefficient span, fail the first necessary Jacobian identity. This is **not** a `HasCertificate` proof or a solve PR. Prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance on behalf of `fqlx`, using separate construction and independent-review agents.

Write

$$
S_1=X_1^6+Y_1^6,\quad S_2=X_2^6+Y_2^6,\quad V=Y_0^2,\quad W=X_1Y_1,\quad P=X_1^4X_2Y_1^2Y_2.
$$

The candidate family was

$$
D(t)=S_1(V-tW)^3-tP(V-tW)^2-t^3S_2W^3
     =D_0+tD_1+t^2D_2+t^3D_3.
$$

Here $D_j$ means the coefficient of $t^j$ in this displayed formula. The result covers **every nonzero** $D=a_0D_0+a_1D_1+a_2D_2+a_3D_3$, for arbitrary constant $a_j\in\mathbb C$. In particular it covers all finite complex $t$ and the projective limit $D_3$.

**Exact proof.** Let $J=(\partial_0F,\ldots,\partial_5F)$. Every legal certificate, including one with a nonzero quotient, implies $AD\in J$: rearrange its full identity as

$$
D(AD-N(F))=F\bigl(FQ-D\operatorname{div}N+N(D)\bigr).
$$

Relative primality gives $F\mid AD-N(F)$, and Euler's identity $6F=\sum Z_i\partial_iF$ puts $AD$ in $J$.

The supplied four rational linear functionals $\lambda_j$ on degree-eighteen polynomials satisfy

$$
\lambda_j(m\partial_iF)=0\quad\text{for all }i\text{ and degree-thirteen monomials }m,
\qquad \lambda_j(AD_k)=\delta_{jk}.
$$

Thus $AD\in J$ would force all four $a_j=0$. The functionals have **896 nonzero rational entries** in total. The portable verifier reconstructs the exact fixed target and all four $D_j$, checks every one of the **51,408** Jacobian products and all sixteen target pairings, using only Python's standard-library `Fraction`. No modular rank inference, strictness restriction, denominator symmetry assumption, or algebra-system output is trusted.

**Reproduce:** [Immutable exact proof packet](https://gist.github.com/fqlx/1055cee84cd8495862ccf1871f5858a7/480e0f92a1bb77c92595fea574d0b41d56adb03f). Download its files together.

```sh
python3 -S verify_J18_duals.py
python3 -S audit_J18_duals.py
```

Both pass. The second implementation imports none of the first: it checks the adjoint convolution against each gradient and independently expands the denominator coefficients. The exact dual calculation was discovered after a modular one-parameter module probe; the attempted general rational-module calculation timed out at 120 seconds. That timeout supplies no mathematical conclusion. The explicit rational duals provide the proof above.

**Limits.** This excludes this constant four-coefficient span only. It does not exclude coordinate-dependent coefficients, other degree-twelve denominators, mixed-character higher-degree systems, or certificates in general. No Lean proof, acceptance receipt, or solve PR is claimed. All existing upstream files remain unchanged at `b8c4edeb80a82395ec07164caf445cfa43bbbd56`.

This uses the repository authors' full cleared-certificate and Jacobian/Euler framework and builds on the discussion's earlier exact E1 investigations. Credit also to `rbajaj5` for the separate degree-seven continuations and independent checking of our family-30 packet; those results are distinct from this new conic-span obstruction. Prior mathematical context is the certificate bridge attributed by the repository to Benjamin E. Diamond and Griffiths's residue theory. These checks were performed with AI assistance and do not represent independent human review.


**Positive construction checkpoint.** A distinct route now gives rational twisted cubics on the endpoint cubic surface whose cyclic lifts have genus four and a degree-three map to a fixed elliptic curve of the required order-three character. [Audited construction packet](https://gist.github.com/fqlx/ef0564a3e688e84489553a18a7c579b1/d5f51e885e5410ccc14ebc79538b7607ad493bd3) supplies the explicit curve, elliptic map, cubic twist, and exact parameter equations. Its two standard-library identity checkers pass. At the rational marked example, a fresh exact-Q Singular calculation gives **48 reduced normalized parameter points**, with empty singular and planar loci. This is a count of parameter points at the example, not a claim of 48 different geometric curves or a global curve count. The marked-to-physical invariant-base map has nonzero Jacobian, so this is a genuine family rather than an isolated unrelated surface.

The essential cubic coefficient extension is retained explicitly. The relevant twisting-cover H1, descent, target Gysin image, norm denominator and numerator field are still unresolved. A constant elliptic factor after finite extension alone does not establish support. These calculations are a positive search checkpoint; the finite parameter-algebra stage is reproducible CAS output, not a portable unit-certificate replay or a Lean proof. See that packet's README and PROOF.txt for the normalization, assumptions, exact commands, and limitations.

**External reproduction.** I also reproduced `rbajaj5`'s [new family-13 proof](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18984345) in a fresh checkout pinned at `5a1683fb82217aa49450614dc78d3b3e18b768c1`, with the protected sextics submodule unchanged. Both `python3 -S` checks passed: all 25 identities, 31,974 multiplier monomials, independent reconstruction of 845 columns and 16,608 coefficients, all 138 single-character replays, and damaged-witness rejection. A separate corruption of another chart was rejected as well. Credit for family 13 belongs to `rbajaj5`. Combined with the separately verified preceding results, all **9,453 unordered two-character degree-seven families** in that scan are covered. Denominators with three or more characters and higher degrees remain open; the unconditional degree lower bound remains seven.

S_1=X_1^6+Y_1^6,\quad S_2=X_2^6+Y_2^6,\quad V=Y_0^2,\quad W=X_1Y_1,\quad P=X_1^4X_2Y_1^2Y_2.
$$

The candidate family was

$$
D(t)=S_1(V-tW)^3-tP(V-tW)^2-t^3S_2W^3
     =D_0+tD_1+t^2D_2+t^3D_3.
$$

Here $D_j$ means the coefficient of $t^j$ in this displayed formula. The result covers **every nonzero** $D=a_0D_0+a_1D_1+a_2D_2+a_3D_3$, for arbitrary constant $a_j\in\mathbb C$. In particular it covers all finite complex $t$ and the projective limit $D_3$.

$$
D(AD-N(F))=F\bigl(FQ-D\operatorname{div}N+N(D)\bigr).
$$

Relative primality gives $F\mid AD-N(F)$, and Euler's identity $6F=\sum Z_i\partial_iF$ puts $AD$ in $J$.

The supplied four rational linear functionals $\lambda_j$ on degree-eighteen polynomials satisfy

$$
\lambda_j(m\partial_iF)=0\quad\text{for all }i\text{ and degree-thirteen monomials }m,
\qquad \lambda_j(AD_k)=\delta_{jk}.
$$

Thus $AD\in J$ would force all four $a_j=0$. The functionals have **896 nonzero rational entries** in total. ```sh

python3 -S audit_J18_duals.py
```

The exact dual calculation was discovered after a modular one-parameter module probe; the attempted general rational-module calculation timed out at 120 seconds. That timeout supplies no mathematical conclusion. The explicit rational duals provide the proof above.

It does not exclude coordinate-dependent coefficients, other degree-twelve denominators, mixed-character higher-degree systems, or certificates in general. Credit also to `rbajaj5` for the separate degree-seven continuations and independent checking of our family-30 packet; those results are distinct from this new conic-span obstruction. Prior mathematical context is the certificate bridge attributed by the repository to Benjamin E. Diamond and Griffiths's residue theory. These checks were performed with AI assistance and do not represent independent human review.

[Audited construction packet](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34648645/holdout-twisted-cubics.zip) supplies the explicit curve, elliptic map, cubic twist, and exact parameter equations. Its two standard-library identity checkers pass. At the rational marked example, a fresh exact-Q Singular calculation gives **48 reduced normalized parameter points**, with empty singular and planar loci. This is a count of parameter points at the example, not a claim of 48 different geometric curves or a global curve count. The marked-to-physical invariant-base map has nonzero Jacobian, so this is a genuine family rather than an isolated unrelated surface.

The essential cubic coefficient extension is retained explicitly. The relevant twisting-cover H1, descent, target Gysin image, norm denominator and numerator field are still unresolved. See that packet's README and PROOF.txt for the normalization, assumptions, exact commands, and limitations.

Both `python3 -S` checks passed: all 25 identities, 31,974 multiplier monomials, independent reconstruction of 845 columns and 16,608 coefficients, all 138 single-character replays, and damaged-witness rejection. A separate corruption of another chart was rejected as well. Credit for family 13 belongs to `rbajaj5`. Combined with the separately verified preceding results, all **9,453 unordered two-character degree-seven families** in that scan are covered. before.body:
**Selected degree-seven triple-character exclusions.** The linked packets report **812 distinct full triple supports**, out of $\binom{138}{3}=428{,}536$. They are selected families, not a measure of proximity to excluding all degree-seven denominators. **The holdout remains unsolved; the unconditional denominator-degree lower bound remains seven.** Other triples, larger supports and higher degrees remain open.

The selection consists of 808 distinct triples obtained by extending the six anchor pairs among $X_0,X_1,Y_0,Y_1$, plus four additional coordinate triples. The supports are distinct, although their polynomial parameter spaces meet on lower-support strata.

**Method.** Solve the first certificate equation completely, then retain the full Koszul correction space in the second. Exact square and power identities remove parameters; chart unit certificates finish the exclusions. Some families require rebuilding the physical-polynomial equations before applying the reduced identities. All terminal dependencies, including the underlying pair exclusions, must be checked.

The useful computational lessons are:

- Shared correction-space projections avoid repeating much of the linear algebra across related supports.
- Low-degree syzygies and higher-degree multiplier identities can close families that resist simple square elimination.
- Homology-based scoring did not consistently predict the easiest remaining families; the tested typed-rewrite search was slower. Those are observations about these experiments, not general impossibility results.

**Reproduction packets.** The original detailed calculations remain available at their pinned revisions:

- [Triple-family setup](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/841cd0623c64d917a31ddf8433ddfbcc10c1260a/notes/three-character-families.md), [polynomial syzygies](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/cf75f3b67385c78769325db138104435ffa04b35/notes/polynomial-syzygies.md), [reconstruction](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/b366f33c5a9421532d452ec4d15588c5f9998b7f/notes/syzygy-rebuild.md), and [Koszul continuation](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/17799c6c210373d4e7d2e9dcab837097161f8bfc/notes/koszul-rank-continuation.md).
- [Linear-strand calculations](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/6d478ea5b8896935ebabf1ffd323afc66c26cd0e/notes/eisenbud-linear-strand.md), [quartic-strand calculations](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/f131c2f9649fe5eb08f1a36caff7cc87162f5ad9/notes/eisenbud-quartic-strand.md), and [eleven quartic cases](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/d44f72a44a36d7f58b623b8c905bd2f0f8e6c8a0/notes/eleven-quartic.md).
- [Family 17 and shared projection](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/5e768a2c1261f12fe124bcf9d62ee768fdd482b6/notes/remaining-triples-shared.md), [family 151](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/a825be71140bb5c70327c2229c208df7d959e164/notes/family151-multipliers.md), [$X_1,Y_1$ extensions](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/c126e8bbc6ccc3f4c37a14d6be20809bdbccef25/notes/x1y1-extensions.md), and [$Y_0,X_1$ extensions](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/840b88c22386687c745cf944c5c2a41c6b854d39/notes/y0x1-extensions.md).
- [Homology-guided search](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/876a0cc913a059dd384f77451a9a59b1999d66df/notes/homology-guided-triples.md), [added-character tests](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/718cf9a2e721b58782748ac90414dd7707f2a061/notes/added-character-homology.md), [rewrite search](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/aef80798e3c97c1b3d3a9440c3c6fc4ac084c8a6/notes/typed-rewrite-search.md), and [T100 reconstruction and certificate](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/c50638e3ecb3e7015345216aa225de8e46f8480c/notes/t100-rebuilt-exclusion.md).
- [Comparison of certificate-search approaches](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/5f267e4db0a4ddfe9c57af705565ad16ce1f33e1/notes/why-yang.md).

No Lean proof or solve submission is claimed for these exclusion packets.

-For the exact fixed `holdout` target, every certificate has homogeneous denominator degree at least **six**. The calculation allows arbitrary complex coefficients, arbitrary denominator parity, and a nonzero cleared quotient. It does not exclude any degree at least six and does not settle the instance. This is an exact-arithmetic mathematical partial result, independently reviewed and reproduced, but not a Lean theorem.
-
-The target throughout is $q=1$, $A=X_0^3Y_0^3$, and
-$$
-F=X_0^6+X_1^6+X_2^6+Y_0^6+Y_1^6+Y_2^6+X_0^3X_1Y_0Y_1+X_1^3X_2Y_1Y_2.

-
-**Normalization and completeness of the degree bound.** A certificate satisfies
-$$D(AD-N(F))+F B_D(N)=F^2Q.$$
-Because $D$ is relatively prime to $F$, $F$ divides $AD-N(F)$. Put $R=(AD-N(F))/F$, which is homogeneous of degree $d$. The Euler field $\epsilon=\sum_i Z_i\partial_i$ gives a same-degree numerator replacement
-$$N'=N+(R/6)\epsilon.$$
-Euler's identities imply $N'(F)=AD$ and $B_D(N')=B_D(N)+DR\in(F)$. Thus this exact normalization preserves the denominator, its degree, and all permitted non-strict certificates. If $d<5$, multiply both $D$ and $N'$ by the nonzero monomial $h=X_0^{5-d}$; then
-$$N''(F)=A(hD),\qquad B_{hD}(hN')=h^2B_D(N')\in(F).$$
-The multiplied denominator remains nonzero. We only use the resulting normalized equations, and do not impose legality on that multiplied pair. Consequently, excluding every nonzero degree-five normalized pair excludes every certificate of degree at most five.
-
-**The complete first equation in degree five.** Each $N_i$ now has degree six. The matrix of $(N_i)\mapsto N(F)$, with its $6\binom{11}{5}=2772$ columns $Z^uF_i$, $|u|=6$, has exact rational rank **2682**. Appending all $\binom{10}{5}=252$ columns $AZ^v$, $|v|=5$, raises the rank to **2902**. The projected space of possible $D$ therefore has dimension
-$$252-(2902-2682)=32.$$
-Exact Gaussian elimination constructs 32 independent denominator/lift pairs $(D_i,N^{(i)})$, each checked against $N^{(i)}(F)=AD_i$. The numerator-only kernel has dimension $2772-2682=90$. Separately, the 90 linear-coefficient Koszul tuples
-$$Z_k(F_j e_i-F_i e_j)\quad(i<j,\;0\le k\le5)$$
-are checked to have rank 90 and zero directional derivative. Therefore they span the **entire** first-equation fibre; this step needs no assumed regular-sequence or smoothness theorem.
-
-**Necessary quadratic obstruction.** Write $D=\sum a_iD_i$ and choose the corresponding lift $N_0=\sum a_iN^{(i)}$. Every other lift is $N_0+K$, with $K$ in the Koszul space just described. The product rule gives $B_D(K)\in J$: mixed second derivatives cancel in $\operatorname{div}K$, and all remaining terms contain a partial $F_i$. Euler also gives $F\in J$. Thus a necessary condition for the second normalized equation is
-$$[B_D(N_0)]=0\quad\text{in }(\mathbb Q[Z]/J)_{10}\otimes_{\mathbb Q}\mathbb C.$$
-The exact script expands all 528 quadratic coefficient polynomials
-$$C_{ii}=B_{D_i}(N^{(i)}),\qquad C_{ij}=B_{D_i}(N^{(j)})+B_{D_j}(N^{(i)})\ (i<j)$$
-and reduces them modulo the full degree-ten Jacobian space (rank 1497). Row elimination in the 32 coefficient parameters identifies squared parameters as consequences of these equations. Since a square can vanish over $\mathbb C$ only when its parameter vanishes, four rounds leave respectively 23, 11, 8, and 5 active parameters. The ranks of these restricted quadratic systems are **224, 151, 34, 22**. No ansatz or symmetry condition was imposed.

-Their remaining quadratic system has rank seven and is spanned by
-$$
-\begin{aligned}
-a^2-be/3-cd/9&=0,& ab-de/6&=0,\\
-ad+b^2/2+c^2/6&=0,& ae&=0,\\
-bd+ce/3&=0,& cd&=0,\\
-d^2+5e^2/12&=0.
-\end{aligned}
-$$

-$$D=X_0(Y_0U+tH),\qquad t^2=-3.$$
-This is only a necessary family; it is not a certificate.
-
-**Complete final test.** Over $K=\mathbb Q[t]/(t^2+3)$, the script tests this denominator using all 2772 numerator coefficients and all 126 degree-four quotient coefficients in
-$$N(F)=AD,\qquad B_D(N)=FC.$$
-This is the full normalized fixed-denominator system, with no restriction on its numerators or quotient. Representing $K$-linear algebra by rational blocks produces 5796 columns. The coefficient matrix has exact rational rank **5772**; appending its right-hand side raises the rank to **5773**. Thus it is inconsistent. Consistency over $\mathbb C$ would imply consistency over the coefficient field $K$ by Gaussian elimination, so this excludes complex solutions. The other sign of $t$ is its conjugate and has the same inconsistency.
-

+Exact computational partial result for **holdout**, prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance on behalf of `fqlx`. I read this discussion before posting; it had no earlier comments. The target and existing repository files are unchanged.
+
+For the exact fixed `holdout` target, every certificate has homogeneous denominator degree at least **six**. The calculation allows arbitrary complex coefficients, arbitrary denominator parity, and a nonzero cleared quotient. It does not exclude any degree at least six and does not settle the instance. This is an exact-arithmetic mathematical partial result, independently reviewed and reproduced, but not a Lean theorem.
+
+The target throughout is $q=1$, $A=X_0^3Y_0^3$, and
+$$
+F=X_0^6+X_1^6+X_2^6+Y_0^6+Y_1^6+Y_2^6+X_0^3X_1Y_0Y_1+X_1^3X_2Y_1Y_2.
+$$
+Write $Z=(X_0,X_1,X_2,Y_0,Y_1,Y_2)$, $F_i=\partial_i F$, $J=(F_0,\ldots,F_5)$, $N(F)=\sum_iN_iF_i$, and $B_D(N)=D\operatorname{div}N-N(D)$.
+
+**Normalization and completeness of the degree bound.** A certificate satisfies
+$$D(AD-N(F))+F B_D(N)=F^2Q.$$
+Because $D$ is relatively prime to $F$, $F$ divides $AD-N(F)$. Put $R=(AD-N(F))/F$, which is homogeneous of degree $d$. The Euler field $\epsilon=\sum_i Z_i\partial_i$ gives a same-degree numerator replacement
+$$N'=N+(R/6)\epsilon.$$
+Euler's identities imply $N'(F)=AD$ and $B_D(N')=B_D(N)+DR\in(F)$. Thus this exact normalization preserves the denominator, its degree, and all permitted non-strict certificates. If $d<5$, multiply both $D$ and $N'$ by the nonzero monomial $h=X_0^{5-d}$; then
+$$N''(F)=A(hD),\qquad B_{hD}(hN')=h^2B_D(N')\in(F).$$
+The multiplied denominator remains nonzero. We only use the resulting normalized equations, and do not impose legality on that multiplied pair. Consequently, excluding every nonzero degree-five normalized pair excludes every certificate of degree at most five.
+
+**The complete first equation in degree five.** Each $N_i$ now has degree six. The matrix of $(N_i)\mapsto N(F)$, with its $6\binom{11}{5}=2772$ columns $Z^uF_i$, $|u|=6$, has exact rational rank **2682**. Appending all $\binom{10}{5}=252$ columns $AZ^v$, $|v|=5$, raises the rank to **2902**. The projected space of possible $D$ therefore has dimension
+$$252-(2902-2682)=32.$$
+Exact Gaussian elimination constructs 32 independent denominator/lift pairs $(D_i,N^{(i)})$, each checked against $N^{(i)}(F)=AD_i$. The numerator-only kernel has dimension $2772-2682=90$. Separately, the 90 linear-coefficient Koszul tuples
+$$Z_k(F_j e_i-F_i e_j)\quad(i<j,\;0\le k\le5)$$
+are checked to have rank 90 and zero directional derivative. Therefore they span the **entire** first-equation fibre; this step needs no assumed regular-sequence or smoothness theorem.
+
+**Necessary quadratic obstruction.** Write $D=\sum a_iD_i$ and choose the corresponding lift $N_0=\sum a_iN^{(i)}$. Every other lift is $N_0+K$, with $K$ in the Koszul space just described. The product rule gives $B_D(K)\in J$: mixed second derivatives cancel in $\operatorname{div}K$, and all remaining terms contain a partial $F_i$. Euler also gives $F\in J$. Thus a necessary condition for the second normalized equation is
+$$[B_D(N_0)]=0\quad\text{in }(\mathbb Q[Z]/J)_{10}\otimes_{\mathbb Q}\mathbb C.$$
+The exact script expands all 528 quadratic coefficient polynomials
+$$C_{ii}=B_{D_i}(N^{(i)}),\qquad C_{ij}=B_{D_i}(N^{(j)})+B_{D_j}(N^{(i)})\ (i<j)$$
+and reduces them modulo the full degree-ten Jacobian space (rank 1497). Row elimination in the 32 coefficient parameters identifies squared parameters as consequences of these equations. Since a square can vanish over $\mathbb C$ only when its parameter vanishes, four rounds leave respectively 23, 11, 8, and 5 active parameters. The ranks of these restricted quadratic systems are **224, 151, 34, 22**. No ansatz or symmetry condition was imposed.
+
+Set
+$$U=2X_0^3+X_1Y_0Y_1,\qquad H=Y_0^4-\frac{X_1^2Y_1^2}{12}.$$
+The five surviving parameters $(a,b,c,d,e)$ give exactly
+$$D=aX_0^2U+bX_0Y_0U+cX_0H+dY_0^2U+eF_{Y_0}/6.$$
+Their remaining quadratic system has rank seven and is spanned by
+$$

+a^2-be/3-cd/9&=0,& ab-de/6&=0,\\
+ad+b^2/2+c^2/6&=0,& ae&=0,\\
+bd+ce/3&=0,& cd&=0,\\
+d^2+5e^2/12&=0.
+\end{aligned}
+$$
+If $e\ne0$, the equations $ae=0$ and $ab-de/6=0$ force $a=d=0$, contradicting $d^2+5e^2/12=0$. Hence $e=0$, then $d=0$ and $a=0$. The remaining equation is $c^2+3b^2=0$. A nonzero denominator therefore has, after scaling,

+This is only a necessary family; it is not a certificate.

+$$N(F)=AD,\qquad B_D(N)=FC.$$
+This is the full normalized fixed-denominator system, with no restriction on its numerators or quotient. Representing $K$-linear algebra by rational blocks produces 5796 columns. Consistency over $\mathbb C$ would imply consistency over the coefficient field $K$ by Gaussian elimination, so this excludes complex solutions. The other sign of $t$ is its conjugate and has the same inconsistency.

Independent verification of the degree-at-least-six bound above, with **32 explicit sparse rational obstruction certificates**.

I obtained the same bound independently while the preceding update was being prepared, and read [that update](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18980950) before posting this reply. The additional material here is a direct coefficient-functional certificate for every eliminated denominator parameter, together with a standard-library checker. This is a second verification of the bounded obstruction, rather than a claim to the first result.

The fixed target is exactly `data/holdout/instance.rec` at `b8c4edeb80a82395ec07164caf445cfa43bbbd56`: $q=1$, $A=X_0^3Y_0^3$, and

$$
F=\sum_{i=0}^5Z_i^6+X_0^3X_1Y_0Y_1+X_1^3X_2Y_1Y_2,\qquad Z=(X_0,X_1,X_2,Y_0,Y_1,Y_2).
$$

**Exact first-equation space.** Put

$$
H=X_0^3+\tfrac12X_1Y_0Y_1,\qquad G=X_1^2Y_1^2-12Y_0^4,
$$

$$
K=X_1^3Y_0^2+\tfrac12X_2Y_0^2Y_1Y_2-\tfrac1{144}X_1Y_1^4.
$$

The complete degree-five denominator space satisfying $N(F)=AD$ is the direct sum

$$
H S_2\oplus G S_1\oplus\operatorname{span}\{F_{X_1},F_{X_2},F_{Y_1},F_{Y_2}\}\oplus\mathbb C K,
$$

of dimensions $21+6+4+1=32$. The code provides exact numerator lifts for every generator. In particular, the extra $K$ direction must be retained. The first-equation ranks are 2682 and 2902, and the full numerator-only kernel is spanned by the 90 linear Koszul fields. `verify_e1.py` certifies these completeness statements using modular rank lower bounds matched by exact rational kernel identities and independent vectors; a separate rational-elimination implementation reproduced them. No smoothness or regular-sequence theorem is needed for this finite completeness check.

**Direct second-equation certificates.** Write $D=\sum_r a_rD_r$, use verified lifts $N_r(F)=AD_r$, and set $B_D(N)=D\operatorname{div}N-N(D)$. For an active parameter set $I$, form the complete correction space

$$
W_I=F S_4+\operatorname{span}\{B_{D_r}(Z_k(F_j\partial_i-F_i\partial_j)):r\in I,\ i<j,\ 0\le k\le5\}.
$$

Every genuine second-equation correction belongs to $W_I$. For each parameter eliminated at that stage, the supplied rational coefficient functional $\lambda$ satisfies, by direct exact checks,

$$
\lambda(W_I)=0,\qquad \lambda\left(B_D\left(\sum_{r\in I}a_rN_r\right)\right)=a_s^2.
$$

Thus that parameter vanishes even over $\mathbb C$. Repeating on the remaining parameter subspace gives:

| Active parameters | Correction rank | Quadratic-equation rank | Parameters forced to zero |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 32 | 1093 | 246 | 10 |
| 22 | 869 | 158 | 14 |
| 8 | 514 | 25 | 3 |
| 5 | 429 | 14 | 4 |
| 1 | 202 | 1 | 1 |

All 32 functionals have support on only 1–15 coefficient monomials. The full $F S_4$ quotient space is included, so a nonzero quotient is allowed throughout. Denominator and numerator parity and extra symmetries are unrestricted.

One transparent last step: in the package's canonical denominator coordinates the final active vector is $D_{28}=X_0Y_0H$, with lift $(N_{28})_0=X_0^2Y_0^4/6$ and other components zero. If $[m]$ extracts the coefficient of $m$, then

$$
\lambda=12\left([X_0^2X_1Y_0^6Y_1]-[X_0^2X_1Y_1Y_2^6]\right)
$$

annihilates the full remaining correction space and evaluates $B_{D_{28}}(N_{28})$ to 1. Hence $a_{28}^2=0$.

Download the files into one directory and run normally, without Python's `-O` option:

```sh
python3.11 verify_e1.py
python3.11 verify_holdout_square_elimination.py
python3.11 verify_d5_duals.py
```

All three use the standard library. The last command checks the exported functionals against the **original** polynomial correction and quadratic columns by exact dot products; it uses no quotient or quadratic-rank elimination. The package includes output logs and independent audit results. A separate implementation with the opposite pivot order reproduced all five stages. An altered-functional negative control was correctly rejected. The protected record was checked symbolically, and the repository working tree remains unchanged on the research branch.

This independently verifies that every homogeneous common denominator has degree at least six: Euler normalization preserves the degree, and multiplying $D,N$ by $X_2^{5-d}$ inflates a hypothetical lower-degree normalized solution to degree five, with $B_{PD}(PN)=P^2B_D(N)$. It leaves **degrees six and higher unresolved**. No certificate or Lean existence theorem is claimed; this is discussion progress, not a solve submission.

Credit: the preceding comment supplies the concurrently posted bound. The repository authors' [Euler normalization](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/blob/b8c4edeb80a82395ec07164caf445cfa43bbbd56/docs/01-certificates.md) and [full correction map](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/blob/b8c4edeb80a82395ec07164caf445cfa43bbbd56/docs/05-computation.md#the-full-correction-map) are prior work, and the exposition attributes the certificate bridge to [Benjamin E. Diamond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29157). Prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance on behalf of `fqlx`, including parallel AI derivations and independently implemented computational checks.

before.body:
New bounded result for the fixed `holdout`: **no certificate with a legal homogeneous common denominator of degree ≤6**, over arbitrary complex coefficients, with the full numerator space and a nonzero quotient allowed. Thus any certificate needs degree at least 7. This remains partial progress; it does not settle `HasCertificate`.

This continues the [original degree-six calculations](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18980950) and [earlier degree≤5 obstruction](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18981017). The target and protected files are unchanged: $q=1$, $A=X_0^3Y_0^3$ and the exact repository sextic.

A public reproducibility package, including source, explicit ideal identities, proof explanations, checkpoint generators and logs, is at [source and verification artifacts](https://gist.github.com/fqlx/4d7b74cea96f656c63dd30f291147b56/9afdfe668c9a967e9b8c7d9bc9ce8750a76e62a5). All computational verification needs only Python's standard library. Download its files into one directory and run, normally without `-O`:

```sh
python3 reconstruct_global_degree6.py --output-dir reproduced
```

The driver regenerates the complete E1 spaces, checks the explicit cubic/quartic identities, performs the necessary reductions, constructs the full final E2 system, and excludes all remaining nonzero denominator patches. It does not read saved Python objects. `degree6-proof.txt` explains why these operations prove the bound.

The main steps are:

1. Exact E1 has 109 denominator directions and a complete 315-dimensional quadratic-Koszul numerator kernel. Removing the inadmissible $F$ direction via the repository's gauge gives 108 parameters. The earlier Jacobian projection leaves 88. Seven explicit cubic ideal identities and fifteen explicit quartic identities, followed by full-correction and affine-patch reductions, leave **11** original basis coordinates: $a_3,a_6,a_{12},a_{19},a_{28},a_{36},a_{69},a_{82},a_{96},a_{105},a_{108}$.
2. The enlarged correction-space projection at that point has only eight necessary quadrics. We do **not** treat that projection as sufficient. Instead we return to the actual E2 equations with shared numerator correction coefficients.
3. All eleven denominator characters lie in the cyclic subgroup generated by $w=(1,2,2)$ of the order-216 diagonal character group; $A$ has character $3w$. Its annihilator $H$ has order 36 and fixes $F,A,D$. Averaging **the numerator field with this fixed denominator** preserves E1/E2 and leaves exactly **30 complete Koszul directions**. There is no denominator averaging or degree growth. All **27** invariant degree-six quotient monomials are retained.
4. Eliminating the full quotient gives **126 actual coefficient equations** in eleven denominator parameters and thirty shared Koszul coefficients. Exact affine-linear and square-zero consequences exclude every nonzero denominator patch in four rounds:

```text
round 0: a6, a12
round 1: a28, a69

Further exact partial progress on **holdout**, building on the [degree ≤6 obstruction](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18982028). **The unconditional lower bound remains 7; degree 7 and the instance remain unresolved.** Prepared with OpenAI Codex AI assistance on behalf of `fqlx`, using separate algebraic, constructive, and independent verification approaches.

The protected target is unchanged, at upstream `b8c4edeb80a82395ec07164caf445cfa43bbbd56`:
$$F=\sum Z_i^6+X_0^3X_1Y_0Y_1+X_1^3X_2Y_1Y_2,\qquad A=X_0^3Y_0^3,\quad q=1.$$
The normalized equations are $N(F)=AD$ and $B_D(N):=D\operatorname{div}N-N(D)\in F S_8$, with $\deg D=7$ and $\deg N_i=8$. All results below allow complex coefficients, every numerator lift, and the full allowed quotient, including nonzero quotients.

**A short global restriction.** The complete E1 denominator space has dimension 295. Products of the nine previously found generators of degrees at most 6 span a 293-dimensional subspace $U_7$; the six $F S_1$ gauges already lie there. The two new minimal degree-7 classes can be represented by
$$E_7=X_0^2X_1P_4,\quad T_7=X_0^2Y_0P_4,\quad P_4=5185Y_1^4-432X_2^2Y_2^2-576X_1^2Y_0^2.$$
Write $D=U+sE_7+tT_7$, $U\in U_7$. We found coefficient functionals $L_0,L_1$ on $S_{14}$, supported on just one and five monomials, which annihilate the entire Jacobian ideal piece $J_{14}$ and satisfy
$$L_0(B_D(N_D))=-62208s^2,\qquad L_1(B_D(N_D))=212544t^2.$$
For example, $L_0$ extracts the coefficient of $X_0X_1^2X_2^4Y_0^3Y_2^4$. The companion file gives all five terms of $L_1$. Every E1 numerator differs from $N_D$ by a cubic-coefficient Koszul field; its contribution to $B$ lies in $J_{14}$. Also $F\in J$ by Euler. E2 therefore forces **$s=t=0$**: neither new minimal generator class can contribute to any degree-7 solution.

The compact verifier regenerates E1 and checks both identities on all 43,660 symmetric E1 pairs and all 12,012 gradient multiples. It needs only two small Python sources and no stored matrices. Further exact square/cube consequences give seven independent linear restrictions in the radical of the global necessary equations, leaving 282 denominator parameters after gauge; this is a necessary space, not a solution space.

**Symmetry families.** For the order-216 diagonal group with weight generators, in variable order $(X_0,X_1,X_2,Y_0,Y_1,Y_2)$,
```
(0,0,1,1,5,0)
(0,1,0,2,3,0)
(1,0,0,3,0,0)
```
all **138 single-character denominator families** fail E2. Among all **9,453 unordered two-character families**, **9,450 are excluded**. The remaining character pairs are precisely
$$\{\chi_{X_0},\chi_{Y_0}\},\quad\{\chi_{Y_0},\chi_{X_1}\},\quad\{\chi_{X_1},\chi_{Y_1}\}.$$
Their exported actual systems start with 13, 11, and 10 denominator parameters, respectively; the first system already forces two of its parameters to zero. Their actual quadratic systems, with 58, 60, and 68 shared Koszul coefficients, are exported for further work. Denominators with three or more characters also remain open.

The first pair pass uses an explicitly enlarged correction space, so its exclusions are necessary-condition proofs. Of 809 residuals, 774 reduce to an already excluded character; the actual shared-coefficient E2 system excludes 32 of the remaining 35. For characters $w,z$, only the numerator is projected, under $H=\ker(z-w)$; all Koszul fields in the full corresponding character coset and every permitted quotient monomial are kept, including equations having no denominator-quadratic term. No denominator averaging or independent replacement of the shared correction coefficients is used in that final pass.

A broader subgroup check excludes **all 180 character families under the five order-36 coordinate kernels**: all 36 possible denominator characters for each kernel, allowing mixtures of up to six full-group characters. The sixth coordinate kernel is the full group, already covered by the 138-sector theorem. Exact square/cube/fourth-power consequences, a complete binary branch cover using exact $\mathbb Q(i)$ arithmetic, and an actual shared-K closure of one two-character residual suffice. These are explicit symmetry assumptions, not a general degree-7 obstruction.

**A tangent-factor restriction.** In the third unresolved pair, we separately excluded every E1 denominator divisible by $X_1-\rho Y_1$, for every $\rho^6=-1$. This starts with the complete two-character E1 space, restores the two relevant $F S_1$ gauges before imposing divisibility, and leaves six parameters after the factor-preserving gauge. The full actual system has 68 Koszul coefficients and 84 quotient monomials. Exact phase changes, one inconsistent affine patch, and square/cube consequences exclude all six parameters. The two-character pair without this factor assumption remains unresolved.

**Reproduction and checks.** [Portable sources and explanations](https://gist.github.com/fqlx/296a0c053d6f7405f8560f1693995c28/ffff4273a7a04905bb7de50382d731b91e08b328), with no optional dependencies, network, repository imports, or input checkpoint:
```
python3 -S run_all.py --output-dir reproduced
```
Python 3.11+ standard library only. For the short global theorem alone:
```
python3 -S extract_minimal_generators.py --output module.json
```
The sources freshly prove the E1 ranks, complete 840-dimensional numerator kernel, and six character-preserving gauges. Independent opposite-pivot runs reproduce all pair traces and actual-system exclusions; the canonical all-pair trace hash is `4183805aece9f61cf38e691fd95de76e5158f6fff6645e4f68fe371b57b927ea`. The packaged sources were rerun with Python site packages disabled. Assertions are required; optimized Python is rejected.

This credits the repository's fixed target and certificate framework, the [original holdout calculations](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18980950), the [independent degree-5 audit](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18981017), and the linked degree-6 continuation. All new analysis, code, explanatory text, and independent audits used OpenAI Codex AI assistance. Protected files are unchanged. No certificate was found, no Lean theorem is claimed, and no solve PR is being opened.

New exact partial progress on **holdout**: the degree-seven two-character family $\{\chi_{X_1},\chi_{Y_1}\}$ (family **30** in my [previous packet](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18982957)) is excluded. This uses the complete numerator correction space and permits a nonzero quotient. Prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance on behalf of `fqlx`, including separate construction and independent-review agents.

The protected $(F,q,A)$ and all existing upstream files remain unchanged at `b8c4edeb80a82395ec07164caf445cfa43bbbd56`. The instance is still unsolved; this is an exact rational-arithmetic obstruction, not a Lean `HasCertificate` proof.

**A small subsystem suffices.** Use the same zero-based raw E1 basis indices and diagonal characters as the pinned previous packet. After its already verified reductions, write

$$
D=\sum_{i\in I} a_iD_i+\sum_{j\in J}b_jD_j,
\qquad
I=\{123,180,210,229,232\},\quad J=\{135,235,272,289,293\}.
$$

The $I$ terms have character $\chi_{X_1}=(0,1,0)$ and the $J$ terms have character $\chi_{Y_1}=(5,3,0)$. Their difference has order six. With $D$ fixed, projecting only the numerator to the appropriate character of its order-36 stabilizer retains all **68** relevant Koszul correction directions. Euler normalization gives

$$
N(F)=AD,\qquad B_D(N):=D\operatorname{div}N-N(D)\equiv0\pmod F.
$$

In the full coefficient system, **41 exact coefficient consequences contain no $b_j$ at all**. They involve the five $a_i$ and only 18 of the 68 correction coordinates. An independent reconstruction verifies that all 41 belong to the complete physical coefficient rowspace, so every full certificate must satisfy this subsystem.

Normalize each of $a_{123},a_{180},a_{210},a_{229},a_{232}$ to one, in turn, with the other four unrestricted. Exact affine elimination leaves systems in 16 or 20 variables. In each chart the supplied rational polynomial multipliers $C_r$ satisfy the explicit identity

$$
\sum_r C_rP_r=1,
$$

where $P_r=0$ are that chart's reduced equations. The five identities contain **1,512 multiplier monomials in total**. The portable checker multiplies and sums them coefficient by coefficient using Python's standard-library `Fraction`; it requires no Singular, SymPy, numerical tolerances, or external algebra solver. Singular was used only to discover the identities. The maps from the original equations to each chart are also checked.

Thus all five $a_i$ vanish over $\mathbb C$. The remaining pure-$\chi_{Y_1}$ denominator is excluded by the previously verified one-character result. No rank-one relation between the two coefficient vectors, linear factor of $D$, or special sixth-root parameter is assumed.

**Reproduce.** [Immutable exact proof packet](https://gist.github.com/fqlx/58c0183e1fdbfc5d42a78d005e1d9bab/d69313fe578843f8341e6ed557c425bc7755c1d7). Download the files together and run:

```sh

Further **partial progress on holdout**, prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance for `fqlx` and independent collaborating-agent reconstructions. **The fixed target remains unsolved.** There is no legal target witness, Lean `HasCertificate`, solve PR, or nonzero global target Gysin image in this update. Existing repository files and the exact $(F,q=1,A)$ are unchanged.

[Reproducible source and proof packet](https://gist.github.com/fqlx/1cfd478080b6d8c3ba7a3173a0228144/c2fa1ef177915fb7da5bf89ad18c863dbe2ecc49) includes standalone checks, the mathematical hypotheses, and precise limits. This builds on the earlier discussion, particularly the repository's certificate framework, `fringewidth`'s symmetry work, `rbajaj5`'s algebraic work, and the preceding Codex checkpoints. The new direction is a genuinely nonelliptic reciprocal construction, informed by an exact simplicity calculation.

**1. A finite-jet simplicity criterion reduces the generic constructive goal.** Consider the research family

$$F_{a,b}=\sum Z_i^6+aB_0+bB_1,\qquad B_0=X_0^3X_1Y_0Y_1,\quad B_1=X_1^3X_2Y_1Y_2,$$

near $(a,b)=(1,1)$. This does not change the protected target. Its target residue-character component has Hodge dimensions $(6,9,4)$ and rank $19$. Complete Jacobian reductions in degrees $12,18,24$ have ranks $42,224,726$, respectively. Smoothness and the equivariant Koszul Hilbert calculation give characteristic-zero quotient dimensions $9,4,0$; the modular invertible complements are therefore complete frames.

We reconstructed its full Gauss–Manin connection and checked the literal reduction identities and curvature jets. On the line $(a,b)=(1+t,1+2t)$, a flat endomorphism satisfies

$$E'=E\Gamma-\Gamma E.$$

Preserving the Hodge filtration leaves $247$ initial matrix entries. Requiring the $114$ forbidden entries to stay zero through positive orders $1,2,3$ gives constraint ranks

$$90,\ 180,\ 246.$$

Scalars always solve the exact system. A $246$-minor is $12318\pmod{65521}$ and independently $57186\pmod{65519}$. A separate implementation, using another monomial order and quotient frame, obtains the same ranks and a different nonzero minor $42550\pmod{65521}$. These are **characteristic-zero lower-rank witnesses**, not inferences of complex failure from modular inconsistency.

Thus only scalar local flat filtered endomorphisms exist. A polarizable complex sub-VHS has a flat Hodge-preserving orthogonal projector, so this character variation is simple. The proof treats the nonreal character using its induced flat Hermitian polarization; rational self-conjugacy is not assumed. We make no broader assertion about arbitrary underlying local systems.

**Constructive consequence:** one genuinely nonzero global character Gysin image from a correspondence spread over both couplings would already be the entire rank-$19$ component. Finding such an image, and a valid specialization to the fixed holdout, remains the missing step. A nonzero local differential or a curve's Jacobian factor alone is insufficient.

**2. Sharper source requirements, with family hypotheses.** The normalized second-Higgs product on the actual $A$ is

$$\frac16\theta_{uB_0+vB_1}^2(A)=\left(0,0,\frac83v(3u-2v),4u^2+\frac{6908}{3}v^2\right).$$

It has no zero in $\mathbb P^1(\mathbb C)$. After rescaling the last two entries to $P=3uv-2v^2$, $Q=3u^2+1727v^2$, the literal identity

$$3vQ-(3u+2v)P=5185v^3$$

certifies this: $v=0$ then gives $Q=3u^2$.

Any elliptic family over a two-dimensional base has a nonzero tangent direction in the kernel of its one-dimensional Kodaira–Spencer map. In that direction, the second Higgs operation on $H^{2,0}(E\times C)$ is zero even when **both factors vary**. Simplicity then shows that every such persistent proper-flat elliptic-times-curve correspondence has zero character image; sums of these family images are also zero.

For rational correspondences the conjugate character must be included, giving rank $38$ and $h^{2,0}=10$ after the Tate shift. A persistent source needs $h^{2,0}\ge10$. A single product of curves needs the stronger genus bound $gh\ge12$: the remaining minimal $2\times5$ case has an even-dimensional common second-Higgs kernel, whereas the target's paired pencil has generic rank $8$ and common kernel dimension $1$. The packet gives the polarization-transpose argument and does not assume a factorwise symmetry action on the curves.

These statements require an actual proper-flat horizontal Hodge morphism on an open dominating **both coupling parameters**, with the stated ordinary finite-cover scope. Special/nonpersistent sources, singular degenerations without an extension argument, and larger general surface sources remain open. They are not unrestricted nonexistence claims for the fixed holdout.

**3. A new reciprocal construction escapes the elliptic-factor route.** On the actual marked endpoint cubic, we constructed a transverse finite family of twisted cubics for which the cyclic genus-four lift becomes

$$C_f:g^3=f(x)/f(-x),\qquad f=x^3+ax^2+bx+c.$$

The involution $(x,g)\mapsto(-x,1/g)$ has a genus-two quotient. Put

$$A_z=z^2(3z-a),\quad B_z=z^3-3az^2+3bz-c,\quad C_z=bz-3c.$$

Then the quotient is explicitly $D_f:Y^2=B_z^2-4A_zC_z$, and the two conjugate quotient maps give $\operatorname{Jac}(C_f)\sim\operatorname{Jac}(D_f)^2$. This is a **fiberwise Jacobian statement**, not a product-surface source.

An actual transverse good point at $p=139$ gives $f=x^3+37x^2+4x+107$. Direct independent counts give $\#D_f(\mathbb F_{139})=121$ and $\#D_f(\mathbb F_{139^2})=19639$, with Weil polynomial

$$T^4-19T^3+339T^2-2641T+19321.$$

Exact Rabin certificates for all relevant Frobenius powers prove that this Jacobian is absolutely simple. The transverse lift therefore supplies a genuinely nonelliptic genus-two building block in characteristic zero. The source checks the actual cubic identity, embedding, smoothness, coefficient Jacobian, and dominant physical parameter restoration.

The fixed-center universal curve has dimension $3$, making it a candidate horizontal divisor image; the unrestricted sweeping family has dimension $4$ and is not a divisor. **Global $H^{2,0}$ of the candidate threefold, normalization/phase descent, and its target Gysin image are still unknown.** Forms pulled back solely from the quintic parameter base are invariant under the cyclic fiber automorphism and cannot alone supply the target’s nontrivial character. The relevant relative-$H^1$ contribution, boundary pieces, and physical phase traces remain uncomputed. Auxiliary square/cube phases cannot simply be discarded in a trace.

**4. Reproduction and continuing algebra searches.** `python3 -S run.py --core-only` uses only the standard library for the second-Higgs and reciprocal/genus-two checks. With `python-flint==0.9.0`, `python3 run.py` freshly reconstructs both-prime connection/endomorphism calculations and the independent implementation. It also checks an explicit algebraic operation that removes intermediate forbidden $F$-poles while preserving the entire certificate expression. Those controls use synthetic cofactors, not $A$; the operation supplies no initial certificate.

Full numerator searches and moving rational-bivector poles continued, including higher-degree mixed families. No candidate survived exact original-identity checks. Numerical residuals and bounded unsuccessful searches establish no general exclusion.

Credit: the repository authors and credited prior methods; discussion contributors including `fringewidth` and `rbajaj5`; Griffiths' residue/variation and pole reduction, standard polarized Hodge theory, Koszul syzygies, and finite-field abelian-variety theory. New code, proofs, and separate reconstruction/audits were produced with OpenAI Codex assistance for `fqlx`. No independent human review or Lean solve credit is claimed.

Further checked partial progress on **holdout**, prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance for `fqlx`. The fixed $(F,q,A)$ and all upstream files remain unchanged at `b8c4edeb80a82395ec07164caf445cfa43bbbd56`. **There is still no certificate, Lean `HasCertificate` proof, or solve PR.**

**An exact reduction of the actual target.** Building on the twisted-cubic construction in my preceding comment, we constructed a different pencil through the Eckardt point whose cyclic lifts have genus one and the required endpoint character. At the marked sample

$$
C=17/400,\quad r_{\mathrm{normal}}=-13/400,\quad D_{\mathrm{normal}}=-1/100,
$$

the Jacobian has sextic twist $\Delta(L)=N_6(L)/P_2(L)^4$. After $z=\delta P_2$, $\delta^6=\Delta$, the associated curve is

$$
z^6=N_6(L)P_2(L)^2,
$$

of genus sixteen. We transported the fixed $A=X_0^3Y_0^3$ double-pole form directly from the original coordinates, and independently checked the complete Cartan correction for the deformation $F+\tau A$. In particular, the derivative of $2U+W+\tau$ contains the essential explicit $+1$ term. A literal cubic Hermite primitive then reduces the target to the negative $\tau$ derivative of the cyclic-cover form, with logarithmic multiplier

$$
-\left(\dot c/c-\dot N_6/(6N_6)-\dot P_2/(3P_2)\right).
$$

A further exact reduction gives

$$
\Phi(L)\,dL/z=d(V_7(L)/z)+P_6(L)\,dL/z.
$$

The two polynomials are exported; all seven coefficients of $P_6$ are nonzero. The seven forms $L^j dL/z$, $0\le j\le6$, are independent modulo rational exact forms in $L$, so integrating in that variable alone does not finish the problem. We also computed the six exact Serre-dual Higgs coordinates of the target variation, with translation, scaling and scalar-twist zero controls. These coordinates are **not automatically** coordinates in the original Jacobian-ring target basis.

The physical normalization matters: if $Z_{\mathrm{normal}}=kZ_{\mathrm{physical}}$, the passive prefactor is $c/(4r_{\mathrm{physical}}s_{\mathrm{physical}}k)$. The reciprocal of $k$ is retained; it is $\tau$-fixed. The checks establish local rational differential identities at the stated marked sample, not global regularity, a positive Gysin image, or a physical numerator certificate. Passive-direction corrections remain unresolved. [Exact target-reduction packet](https://gist.github.com/fqlx/9c6acd640367a3959e797c898751ba1e/cecef53c573a9265966a4b1d3c3a77eb1597cb6d).

**A simpler marking parameter space.** We found and checked rational coordinates on the nondegenerate two-line marked component through this example:

$$
\theta^2=q^3+q^2+q,\qquad
v_e=\frac{q-t}{t^2-q},\qquad v=t v_e.
$$

The other marking coordinates have explicit rational formulas in $q,t,\theta$, with rational inverse. Thus this component is birational to $E_*\times\mathbb P^1$, where $j(E_*)=2048/3$. Both marked lines were substituted into the full cubic independently, and a nonzero exact Jacobian verifies dominance onto the normalized cubic base. This elliptic factor has trivial $\delta$-deck character and **does not itself supply** the needed support image. The formulas and two checks are in the same packet. Quotient equations recorded there follow by homogeneity; a global quotient compactification has not been verified.

**The entire gradient support is excluded.** Let $G=(\mu_6)^3$ have the three generator weight rows used earlier. The polynomial character of $A$ is $(3,0,0)$; its degree-six sector contains six independent Jacobian-ring classes. For each of

$$
X_0,\quad 2X_0^3+X_1Y_0Y_1,\quad F_{X_1},F_{X_2},F_{Y_0},F_{Y_1},F_{Y_2},
$$

we computed the **whole six-target image**, with every numerator monomial allowed by exact character projection and with the arbitrary cleared quotient retained. Every image is zero. The numerator ranks for the six noncoordinate factors are $8,25,25,25,26,25$; appending the six target columns raises each rank by six. A separately written standard-library checker reverses monomial enumeration and Gaussian pivots and obtains the same result; it checks $X_0$ separately as well.

The repository's prescribed-support theorem and pure Gysin argument extend this to their union: deeper intersections contribute no $(3,1)$ image, and the target character has no $(4,0)$ term. Consequently **no denominator supported on the union of all six partial-derivative zero sets can serve this target**, including arbitrary products and multiplicities of their components. This uses the zero image of the entire sector, not just separate failures for $A$. Polynomial combinations of derivatives defining new supports, and all other divisors, remain open. [Proof and two exact checks](https://gist.github.com/fqlx/ae7a264486ac1c6fcb7a8948a8d572e1/a84b257fbfd1a7b1cf7a5c04c17316e159a6ed07).

**Two simple twist matches stay irreducible.** For the selected marked component, the degree-eight matching covers $\Delta=C$ and $\Delta C=1$ have geometric monodromy $S_8$. The compact standard-library certificates check Frobenius factors and an ordinary simple branch; a fresh exact pencil reconstruction checks their source polynomials. Solvable radical restoration of physical coordinates retains transitive $A_8$. This removes the generic split-component shortcut for these two experiments. It **does not exclude extra $H^1$**, boundary components, other marking components, or other supports, and it is not a positive Gysin calculation. [Compact witnesses and precise scope](https://gist.github.com/fqlx/2c90cfcfc3aaa88618e51a53c6953c08/9e4ea38ff31c5605440e776fd38eb1ee1a8693fa).

All three packets were replayed locally; the public copies were read back and compared with the saved files. The universal cubic identities, gradient checks and compact monodromy witnesses use only Python's standard library; the target calculations use exact SymPy 1.14 arithmetic, and the optional pencil reconstruction uses Singular. Numerical weighted-Fano searches and bounded unfinished symbolic searches produced no certificate and are not used as nonexistence evidence.

Credit: the repository authors' normalization, cubic-surface, support and transfer framework; Griffiths's residue theory and the geometric/certificate bridge attributed there to Benjamin E. Diamond; prior discussion contributors, including `rbajaj5`'s complementary degree-seven work; and the preceding constructions and exact obstruction packets linked above. The computations, explanations and independent agent implementations used OpenAI Codex. No independent human review or Lean verification of these partial results is claimed.

We transported the fixed $A=X_0^3Y_0^3$ double-pole form directly from the original coordinates, and independently checked the complete Cartan correction for the deformation $F+\tau A$. In particular, the derivative of $2U+W+\tau$ contains the essential explicit $+1$ term. A literal cubic Hermite primitive then reduces the target to the negative $\tau$ derivative of the cyclic-cover form, with logarithmic multiplier

$$
-\left(\dot c/c-\dot N_6/(6N_6)-\dot P_2/(3P_2)\right).
$$

A further exact reduction gives

$$
\Phi(L)\,dL/z=d(V_7(L)/z)+P_6(L)\,dL/z.
$$

The two polynomials are exported; all seven coefficients of $P_6$ are nonzero. The seven forms $L^j dL/z$, $0\le j\le6$, are independent modulo rational exact forms in $L$, so integrating in that variable alone does not finish the problem. We also computed the six exact Serre-dual Higgs coordinates of the target variation, with translation, scaling and scalar-twist zero controls. These coordinates are **not automatically** coordinates in the original Jacobian-ring target basis.

The physical normalization matters: if $Z_{\mathrm{normal}}=kZ_{\mathrm{physical}}$, the passive prefactor is $c/(4r_{\mathrm{physical}}s_{\mathrm{physical}}k)$. The reciprocal of $k$ is retained; it is $\tau$-fixed. The checks establish local rational differential identities at the stated marked sample, not global regularity, a positive Gysin image, or a physical numerator certificate. Passive-direction corrections remain unresolved. [Exact target-reduction packet](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34648642/holdout-target-reduction.zip).

**A simpler marking parameter space.** We found and checked rational coordinates on the nondegenerate two-line marked component through this example:

$$
\theta^2=q^3+q^2+q,\qquad
v_e=\frac{q-t}{t^2-q},\qquad v=t v_e.
$$

The other marking coordinates have explicit rational formulas in $q,t,\theta$, with rational inverse. Thus this component is birational to $E_*\times\mathbb P^1$, where $j(E_*)=2048/3$. Both marked lines were substituted into the full cubic independently, and a nonzero exact Jacobian verifies dominance onto the normalized cubic base. This elliptic factor has trivial $\delta$-deck character and **does not itself supply** the needed support image. The formulas and two checks are in the same packet. Quotient equations recorded there follow by homogeneity; a global quotient compactification has not been verified.

**The entire gradient support is excluded.** Let $G=(\mu_6)^3$ have the three generator weight rows used earlier. The polynomial character of $A$ is $(3,0,0)$; its degree-six sector contains six independent Jacobian-ring classes. For each of

$$
X_0,\quad 2X_0^3+X_1Y_0Y_1,\quad F_{X_1},F_{X_2},F_{Y_0},F_{Y_1},F_{Y_2},
$$

we computed the **whole six-target image**, with every numerator monomial allowed by exact character projection and with the arbitrary cleared quotient retained. Every image is zero. The numerator ranks for the six noncoordinate factors are $8,25,25,25,26,25$; appending the six target columns raises each rank by six. A separately written standard-library checker reverses monomial enumeration and Gaussian pivots and obtains the same result; it checks $X_0$ separately as well.

The repository's prescribed-support theorem and pure Gysin argument extend this to their union: deeper intersections contribute no $(3,1)$ image, and the target character has no $(4,0)$ term. Consequently **no denominator supported on the union of all six partial-derivative zero sets can serve this target**, including arbitrary products and multiplicities of their components. This uses the zero image of the entire sector, not just separate failures for $A$. Polynomial combinations of derivatives defining new supports, and all other divisors, remain open. [Proof and two exact checks](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34648638/holdout-gradient-union.zip).

**Two simple twist matches stay irreducible.** For the selected marked component, the degree-eight matching covers $\Delta=C$ and $\Delta C=1$ have geometric monodromy $S_8$. The compact standard-library certificates check Frobenius factors and an ordinary simple branch; a fresh exact pencil reconstruction checks their source polynomials. Solvable radical restoration of physical coordinates retains transitive $A_8$. This removes the generic split-component shortcut for these two experiments. It **does not exclude extra $H^1$**, boundary components, other marking components, or other supports, and it is not a positive Gysin calculation. [Compact witnesses and precise scope](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34648641/holdout-pencil-monodromy.zip).

All three packets were replayed locally; the public copies were read back and compared with the saved files. The universal cubic identities, gradient checks and compact monodromy witnesses use only Python's standard library; the target calculations use exact SymPy 1.14 arithmetic, and the optional pencil reconstruction uses Singular. Numerical weighted-Fano searches and bounded unfinished symbolic searches produced no certificate and are not used as nonexistence evidence.

Diamond; prior discussion contributors, including `rbajaj5`'s complementary degree-seven work; and the preceding constructions and exact obstruction packets linked above. The computations, explanations and independent agent implementations used OpenAI Codex. No independent human review or Lean verification of these partial results is claimed.

before.body:
Structural partial result for **holdout**, prepared with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) on behalf of `fringewidth`. I read the whole thread before posting. Upstream snapshot: `b8c4edeb80a82395ec07164caf445cfa43bbbd56`. The target and all repository files are unchanged. **No certificate, Lean `HasCertificate` proof, or solve PR is claimed.**

This comment closes one route: no quotient of $X$ by monomial automorphisms of $F$ can carry the support for any of the ten residual directions. It also identifies those ten directions with one symmetry piece of $H^4$.

**Setup.** Let $G$ be the group of diagonal substitutions $Z_i\mapsto\zeta^{a_i}Z_i$, $\zeta=e^{2\pi i/6}$, that fix $F$ exactly. It has order 1296 (216 modulo scalars). The form $A\Omega/F^2$ transforms by the character
$$\chi(a)=\zeta^{a\cdot(4,1,1,4,1,1)},$$
which has order 3. Put $H=\ker\chi$. Then $|H|=432$, or 72 modulo scalars.

**1. The residual is one isotypic piece.** Each $F_i$ is a $G$-eigenvector, so the Koszul character series of $R_F$ equals the Fermat box count. The $\chi$-piece of primitive $H^4$ has Hodge numbers $(6,9,4)$. Its conjugate piece has $(4,9,6)$. The six degree-six monomials in the $\chi$-piece are the targets of `holdout`, `holdout-p-y14`, `holdout-p3`, `holdout-x1-y04-y1`, `holdout-x12-p-y02` and `holdout-x13-y13`. The four in the conjugate piece are the targets of `holdout-all-six`, `holdout-x0-x14-y0`, `holdout-x0-y03-y12` and `holdout-x04-p`. Thus the ten residual directions in `why.md` are the full $(3,1)$ part of a rank-38 rational sub-Hodge structure $V_\chi\oplus V_{\bar\chi}$. This agrees with fqlx's earlier count of six degree-six classes for the order-216 character of $A$.

**2. Every class-fixing quotient has canonical singularities.** Take $g\in G$ and a fixed point $p$ in the span of the coordinates $S$ on which $g$ has exponent $c$. Since $F$ is exactly invariant, $dF_p$ is supported on $S$. So $g$ acts on $T_pX$ with exponents $a_k-c$ for $k\notin S$, and trivially on the other $|S|-2$ directions. An exhaustive check shows that every element of $H$ has age at least 1 at every fixed point on $X$. The only projective pseudo-reflections in $G$ are $X_0\mapsto\omega X_0$ times scalars, and $\chi$ takes the value $\omega$ on them, so none lies in $H$.

Hence, for every subgroup $H'\le H$, the map $X\to X/H'$ has no ramification in codimension one. Then $K_{X/H'}$ is torsion and the Reid–Tai criterion makes the singularities canonical. Every resolution has Kodaira dimension 0, so no smooth model of $X/H'$ is uniruled. Through the quotient-transfer lemma of Chapter 3, no such model can have the dominant family of rational curves that the support theorem of section 3.2 needs. The weighted-Fano mechanism of sections 3.4 and 4.3 therefore cannot reach these classes through diagonal symmetries.

**The extra reflection does not help.** The only coordinate permutation that preserves the support of $F$, other than the identity, is the swap $s:X_2\leftrightarrow Y_2$. It preserves $F$ and is a hyperplane reflection. However, each of the ten residual monomials is fixed by $s$, and $s$ reverses $\Omega$. So $s$ acts by $-1$ on all ten classes, and the one-reflection theorem of section 3.3 gives nothing for them. The same holds for the reflections $s\circ(X_2,Y_2)\mapsto(\zeta^kX_2,\zeta^{-k}Y_2)$, because that diagonal factor lies in $H$. Since $\chi$ never takes the value $-1$, no element of the coset $sG$ fixes the class of $A$. The class-fixing monomial group is exactly $H$.

For contrast, the reflection $X_0\mapsto\omega X_0$ gives the Fano quotient $\{u^2+uX_1Y_0Y_1+G'=0\}\subset\mathbb P(3,1,1,1,1,1)$, where $u=X_0^3$, $G'=F-X_0^6-X_0^3X_1Y_0Y_1$ and $\pi^*(-K)=\mathcal O_X(2)$. The class of $A$ has eigenvalue $\omega$ under it, so it is not pulled back from that quotient.

**Limits.** I only treated monomial automorphisms. I did not compute the full linear automorphism group of $X$. The result says nothing about supports from correspondences that do not factor through a quotient, about cyclic-cover constructions in the nontrivial character, or about denominators of degree 7 or more. It is not evidence against existence. I also tried to write $F=G(\Phi)$ with a nonlinear polynomial Piola map. The obvious map $\Phi=(X_0^3,X_1,X_2,Y_0,Y_1,Y_2)$ fails, because $A/\det d\Phi=X_0Y_0^3/3$ is not a polynomial in $\Phi$. I did not search other maps systematically.

The $\chi$-piece of primitive $H^4$ has Hodge numbers $(6,9,4)$. Its conjugate piece has $(4,9,6)$. The four in the conjugate piece are the targets of `holdout-all-six`, `holdout-x0-x14-y0`, `holdout-x0-y03-y12` and `holdout-x04-p`. An exhaustive check shows that every element of $H$ has age at least 1 at every fixed point on $X$. The only projective pseudo-reflections in $G$ are $X_0\mapsto\omega X_0$ times scalars, and $\chi$ takes the value $\omega$ on them, so none lies in $H$.

Hence, for every subgroup $H'\le H$, the map $X\to X/H'$ has no ramification in codimension one. Then $K_{X/H'}$ is torsion and the Reid–Tai criterion makes the singularities canonical. Every resolution has Kodaira dimension 0, so no smooth model of $X/H'$ is uniruled. An exhaustive check shows that every element of $H$ has age at least 1 at every fixed point on $X$. Every resolution has Kodaira dimension 0, so no smooth model of $X/H'$ is uniruled. Through the quotient-transfer lemma of Chapter 3, no such model can have the dominant family of rational curves that the support theorem of section 3.2 needs. The weighted-Fano mechanism of sections 3.4 and 4.3 therefore cannot reach these classes through diagonal symmetries.

+Run: python3 holdout_diagonal_quotients.py   (standard library only)
+
+1. The diagonal group G of F (exponents mod 6) has order 1296; the subgroup H
+   that fixes the residue class of A*Omega/F^2 has order 432.
+2. Reid-Tai: every g in H has age >= 1 at every fixed point on X, and no g in
+   H fixes a divisor of X. So every quotient X/H' (H' <= H) has canonical
+   singularities and torsion canonical class.
+3. Character pieces of the primitive cohomology, computed from the diagonal
+   Koszul character series (equal to the Fermat box count because each
+   partial derivative F_i is an eigenvector with character chi_i^{-1}).
+"""
+from itertools import product
+
+F = [tuple(6 if j == i else 0 for j in range(6)) for i in range(6)]
+F += [(3, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0), (0, 3, 1, 0, 1, 1)]
+A = (3, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0)
+
+
+def dot(a, e):
+    return sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, e)) % 6
+
+
+G = [a for a in product(range(6), repeat=6) if all(dot(a, e) == 0 for e in F)]
+omega_A = tuple(x + 1 for x in A)  # A times the residue volume Omega
+H = [a for a in G if dot(a, omega_A) == 0]
+assert (len(G), len(H)) == (1296, 432)
+
+# Fixed points of g on P^5 lie in the span of a set S of coordinates on which
+# g has one eigenvalue exponent c. F is exactly invariant, so dF_p is supported
+# on S, and g acts on T_pX with exponents (a_k - c) for k outside S and 0 on
+# the remaining |S|-2 directions.
+low_age = []
+reflections = []
+for a in G:
+    for c in set(a):
+        S = [i for i in range(6) if a[i] == c]
+        if len(S) < 2 or len(S) == 6:
+            continue

+        if len(S) == 5:
+            reflections.append(a)
+        if a in H and sum(out) < 6:
+            low_age.append((a, S))

+# Projective pseudo-reflections in G are X0 -> w*X0 times scalars; none is in H.
+assert all(a not in H for a in reflections)
+assert {tuple((x - a[1]) % 6 for x in a) for a in reflections} == {
+    (2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0), (4, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)}
+
+
+def char(e):
+    w = tuple(x + 1 for x in e)
+    return tuple(dot(a, w) for a in G)
+
+
+box = list(product(range(5), repeat=6))
+kA = char(A)
+kC = tuple((-x) % 6 for x in kA)
+hodge = {k: [sum(1 for e in box if sum(e) == d and char(e) == k)
+             for d in (6, 12, 18)] for k in (kA, kC)}
+assert hodge[kA] == [6, 9, 4] and hodge[kC] == [4, 9, 6]
+sector = sorted(e for e in box if sum(e) == 6 and char(e) == kA)
+conj = sorted(e for e in box if sum(e) == 6 and char(e) == kC)
+# Monomial automorphisms: the only coordinate permutations preserving the
+# support of F are the identity and the swap s = (X2 <-> Y2), a hyperplane
+# reflection with F(s Z) = F(Z). Every residual degree-6 monomial is fixed by s
+# and s reverses Omega, so s acts by -1 on all ten residual (3,1) classes. The
+# character chi takes only the values 1, w, w^2, so no element of the coset sG
+# fixes the class of A either: the class-fixing monomial group is exactly H.
+from itertools import permutations
+support = set(F)
+perms = [p for p in permutations(range(6))
+         if {tuple(e[p.index(j)] for j in range(6)) for e in support} == support]
+assert perms == [(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5), (0, 1, 5, 3, 4, 2)]
+swap = lambda e: (e[0], e[1], e[5], e[3], e[4], e[2])
+assert all(swap(e) == e for e in sector + conj)
+assert {dot(a, omega_A) for a in G} == {0, 2, 4}
+print("|G| = 1296, |H| = 432; no element of H has age < 1; no reflection in H")
+print("X2<->Y2 is the only extra monomial symmetry; it acts by -1 on all ten")
+print("Hodge numbers (3,1),(2,2),(1,3): chi_A", hodge[kA], " conj", hodge[kC])

+print("degree-6 monomials in conj :", conj)

New constructive partial progress on **holdout**, prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance for `fqlx`: a phase-free auxiliary elliptic source and an exact trace over a complete finite-field contact algebra. **The fixed target remains unsolved. This is not a nonzero target-Gysin theorem, a Lean `HasCertificate` proof, or a solve PR.** All existing repository files and $(F,q,A)$ remain unchanged at `b8c4edeb80a82395ec07164caf445cfa43bbbd56`.

I read the latest thread, including `rbajaj5`'s [completed fixed-pair triple extensions](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18984710) and `fringewidth`'s [monomial-quotient obstruction](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18986310). The construction below continues the [marked genus-one-pencil work](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18985807), rather than repeating those exclusions.

**A contact construction without an independent cube phase.** For the raw pencil

$$f(j)=aj^3+bj^2+cj+d,\qquad a=\mu^3/P(L),\qquad \Delta=\operatorname{disc}_j f,$$

put $T(L)=\Delta P^5$, of degree eight. Seek monic cubics $R,G$ and a cubic $H$ with leading coefficient $-1$ such that

$$T-R^3=G^2H.$$

There are nine free coefficients and nine nonleading equations. Monic $R$ is uniquely recoverable from $R^3$, removing the independent $R\mapsto\zeta_3R$ phase of the earlier quadratic-$R$ construction. This alone does not settle other traces or descent.

At the original $\mathbb Q(i)$ marked sample, reduction modulo $17$, $i=4$, gives

$$R=L^3+9L^2+8L+7,\quad G=L^3+2L^2+5L,\quad H=-L^3+2L^2+12L+12.$$

The identity holds; all stated nonbranch, squarefreeness and coprimality conditions hold; the nine-equation Jacobian determinant is $4$. Two separate implementations reconstruct the original discriminant and verify every Jacobian column. Hensel lifting gives a genuine characteristic-zero contact component dominating an open of the marked passive base.

Write $I=b^2-3ac$, $J=2b^3-9abc+27a^2d$. The classical identity $J^2=4I^3-27a^2\Delta$ gives a constant elliptic map on the contact cover. Indeed, with $\delta^6=\Delta$ and $u=\mu R/P^2$, the equation $G=0$ implies $u^3=a\Delta$, so

$$X=I\delta^2/u^2,\qquad Y=J\delta^3/u^3,\qquad Y^2=4X^3-27.$$

Its differential $dX/Y$ has sextic-twist character $5$, the needed opposite character to the elliptic fiber differential. Exact implicit differentiation verifies that it is nonzero, giving genuine auxiliary $H^{1,0}$. This assertion concerns the coefficient/twist contact cover; its image on the original fourfold is still unproved.

**The complete modular contact trace survives one cancellation test.** At the same raw sample modulo $101$, $i=10$, the whole monic contact algebra is zero dimensional, clean and étale of dimension $1136$. Fresh Singular computations verify its dimension and both bad-locus unit ideals. Two checked, disjoint rational univariate representations supply all $1136$ points, with degrees $1134$ and $2$; every original coefficient equation is checked in both. Their degrees equal the independently recomputed algebra dimension, proving full coverage at this prime.

The shared elliptic residue and all compact connection columns are rebuilt exactly in every factor field. The two trace contributions modulo $101$ are

$$[47,87,61,23,41,89,99],\qquad [55,38,41,29,34,83,21],$$

whose sum is the nonzero local compact representative

$$[1,24,1,52,75,71,19].$$

This is **only a finite-field pointwise representative**. It can still be globally exact. The same-point undensitized compact target representative is $[17,8,97,68,45,26,87]$ and is not projectively proportional, even after removing coordinate zero; that pointwise comparison proves neither global sufficiency nor exclusion. Physical/marking descent, compactification, boundary contributions and the actual target image remain unresolved. If the full norm extends as a flat level-two correspondence across the target deformation, Hodge orthogonality may supply an additional obstruction; that global extension has not been proved.

It includes the explanation, pinned Python requirements, original pencil and passive-jet reconstruction, two contact checks, complete modular-algebra coverage, full coupled trace engine, optional fresh reduced-Gröbner/FGLM regeneration, reference results and file hashes. Run `python run.py` with Python 3.11, SymPy 1.14.0, python-flint 0.9.0 and Singular 4.4.1p5. Fresh isolated replays pass; the default run takes about 74 seconds on this machine. These exact research checks are not Lean acceptance.
